Thirteen comments

Maggie West’s Waltz

This excellent tune was composed by Mairearad Green from Achiltibuie, a young piper and accordionist. An occasional member of the Anna Massie Band, she currently tours with The Box Club and all-female pipe group Tachem.

http://www.mairearadgreen.com/home.html
http://www.boxclub.co.uk/

It was written for her grandmother Maggie who had the nickname Maggie West because she came from the west side of the village.

↳ Posted by kuec on December 14th, 2014.

Maggie West’s, X:5

This is the same melody as setting 1, to which I added the chords of setting 4, and then altered them by adding some chromatisms in the bass. I think that Mairearad also plays the chromatic descent g f# e in the bass that works really well, and adds significantly to the atmosphere of the second part.
